title: `Core\Ldap` is a native LDAPv3 client that binds only by simple bind over TLS, takes filters as values and reads Active Directory's attributes as typed values
scope: The whole surface of `Core\Ldap`: its classes, members and options shapes, the `[ldap.<name>]` block and the three `ldap.*` grants, how a connection binds and when it may bind without TLS, the pool and `authenticate`'s own connection, the search options and the four Active Directory extras, the filter builder and `Ldap\Dn`, the type table, writes and passwords, and the error kinds. Not in scope: which sans-IO codec crate `crates/nvs-ldap` borrows, which Stage 3 of the goal picks under `rule:core-classes/db-crate-boundary`; and the tier, which [0051](0051.md) § 3 already placed.
dependsOnText: [0051](0051.md) § 3 (the Native placement and the escaper in `Core`), [0067](0067.md) (`Core\Db`, whose block, grants, pool and reset this mirrors), [0024](0024.md) (`tainted` and its sink-named launderers), [0063](0063.md) (one paradigm per operation, the options bag), [0088](0088.md) (the sink predicate).
validatedBy: The `ldap` goal's stage checks: `crates/nvs-ldap/tests/` against the `samba-ad` test server, and the `tests/conformance/core/ldap-*.nvst` cases and `tests/hostile/core/Ldap*/` attacks as each stage lands them.
